title: Two ways in
alt: A visitor walks through the public door and is in the public rooms in a few steps. A member of staff walks the other way through each security layer in turn: the fence and gate, the staff entrance and passage, the mantrap, the secure corridor, the data-hall door and the cage round the racks. A red fire separation runs between the two sides.
sources: art HOWDC v2 security layout (security layers street to rack: property line and fence, staff entry, controlled door (mantrap), secure corridor, data hall door, cage and rack)
SPEC rack: Vertiv VR3300, 600 x 1200 x 2000 mm
drawn_generically: the rooms and walls (no real layout)

steps.caption: Visitors walk in the public door, straight into the public rooms.
Staff go the other way, first through the fence and gate.
Then the staff entrance and a mantrap that lets one person in at a time.
A secure corridor leads to the data hall door.
Inside the hall, a cage closes round the racks.
A fire separation divides the public side from the data centre.

camera: starts on the street with the visitor and the member of staff, walks with the member of staff through each layer, then pulls back over the layout (a following view, not a long section)
